default_adapter.name: Default Adapter
default_adapter.hint: Configured Bilibili instance name. Leave empty to use the current Bilibili session or the sole available account.

zh.hint: B站实例的配置名称，留空使用当前B站会话或唯一可用账户。
zh.name: 默认适配器

en.hint: Configured Bilibili instance name. Leave empty to use the current Bilibili session or the sole available account.
en.name: Default Adapter

enable_like.name: Enable Video Likes
enable_like.hint: Allow bili_like_video to set or remove a like.

zh.hint: 允许 bili_like_video 点赞或取消点赞。
zh.name: 启用视频点赞

en.hint: Allow bili_like_video to set or remove a like.
en.name: Enable Video Likes

enable_comment.name: Enable Comments
enable_comment.hint: Allow bili_comment. This does not change automatic incoming comment processing.

zh.hint: 允许 bili_comment，不改变入站评论的自动处理流程。
zh.name: 启用发表评论

en.hint: Allow bili_comment. This does not change automatic incoming comment processing.
en.name: Enable Comments

zh.hint: 允许 bili_post 发布动态。
zh.name: 启用动态发布

request_timeout.name: Request Timeout
request_timeout.hint: Total tool request timeout including queueing, in seconds (5-180). Write requests are never retried automatically.

zh.hint: 工具总超时含排队时间，单位秒，范围5-180；写入请求不自动重试。
zh.name: 请求超时

en.hint: Total tool request timeout including queueing, in seconds (5-180). Write requests are never retried automatically.
en.name: Request Timeout

zh.hint: 同时执行工具操作的上限，范围1-16。
zh.name: 最大并发数

max_count.name: Maximum Page Items
max_count.hint: Maximum feed/search/upload page or comment batch count (5-100); tools default to 5. Upload pages are also capped at 30.

zh.hint: 浏览、搜索、投稿页或首批评论的数量上限，范围5-100；工具默认返回5条，投稿页另有上限30。
zh.name: 每页数量上限

en.hint: Maximum feed/search/upload page or comment batch count (5-100); tools default to 5. Upload pages are also capped at 30.
en.name: Maximum Page Items

subtitle_max_chars.name: Subtitle Preview Characters
subtitle_max_chars.hint: Maximum subtitle text characters returned per call (100-60000). The complete track is attached as SRT.

zh.hint: 每次调用返回的字幕文本字符上限，范围100-60000；完整轨道以SRT附件提供。
zh.name: 字幕预览字符上限

en.hint: Maximum subtitle text characters returned per call (100-60000). The complete track is attached as SRT.
en.name: Subtitle Preview Characters

subtitle_max_bytes.name: Subtitle Download Bytes
subtitle_max_bytes.hint: Maximum downloaded subtitle response bytes (1024-10485760). SRT output is limited to twice this size.

zh.hint: 字幕响应下载字节上限，范围1024-10485760；SRT输出限制为此值的两倍。
zh.name: 字幕下载大小上限

en.hint: Maximum downloaded subtitle response bytes (1024-10485760). SRT output is limited to twice this size.
en.name: Subtitle Download Bytes
